authorization.words: The owner, in the operator session of 2026-11-02 after merging #236 by merge commit (debed530): "Yes. I will merge #236 using a merge commit. After the merge, rerun SP1-PA3D from the beginning." and "Owner authorization remains for exactly one controlled v2 attributed proof." With the lane's limits restated: prefer the qualified self-hosted path; no hosted proving, no production verifier changes, no Solidity changes, no production-binding claims; if the pre-proof attestation refuses, stop; open the PR as a draft and do not merge; do not begin SP1-PA3E.

statement.text: The SP1 guest program mldsa65-withdrawal (ELF sha256 2adddae753011fb08e30127e38befe99c0092c956e01bf4486ca81827a632d8a, 206504 bytes; guest tree f61fdc6c8785df742857574c5dbf47aa62283c49), executed by the canonical-build host binary (sha256 fc8eff69e78e39c5c08bfa0eea2f402d5b67341eb27caae7fd34ff6b456abf1b; host tree 30f72596c430974bf8113892bf41c26dce3629f3) on the committed input fixture zkvm/fixtures/mldsa65-withdrawal.inputs.json (sha256 5f317816068d60b7a4b71fce703a53be933c05a4109cbe432911fb918f80a0e9), commits to the public values whose sha256 is 64e08d05289e38029768a6c070e157ebc6a283896dc34a626691cc4cee7d67db (the values SP1-PA3B's run recorded for the same program and inputs). One Groth16 proof of that execution, made by the local cpu prover from the archive-only circuit v6.1.0 (archive sha256 18beebb6cd0cc9b4d4a240ee4f49511da6c2a7e51724bad4232de538a9147810), is to verify under PROGRAM_VKEY 0x0001a4c62de43425bce9febc352a74acc01bac70c02d8acedc09085c4eb8c2dc on the designated verifier v6.1.0 (verifierHash 0x4388a21c687fdd5f218d7e3d13190cac4c5355818d3605fd5fb811df468ee696). It is an exercise of the self-hosted path and establishes no production binding: PRODUCTION_SP1_BINDING = NOT_ESTABLISHED.

prover.implementation: zkvm/host (the sp1-sdk blocking client, Groth16 through the pinned gnark image), run as the canonical-build host binary mldsa65-host under the archive-only prove gate

environment.description: the developer workstation's WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 virtual machine (x86_64, 24 GiB RAM, 40 GiB swap), with the distribution's own Docker Engine (docker.io) on a unix socket and no Docker Desktop integration; the egress observer runs as root in the VM's root network namespace, which every WSL2 distribution on the machine shares, and the prover as the unprivileged user prover, from a clean clone of the source commit; the same environment SP1-PA3C-Q1 qualified

outputs.token: the first 16 hexadecimal digits of the sha256 of the run observation's committed (LF) bytes

verification.where: the proving host, from a clean checkout at the commit that holds the committed run observation, after the egress boundary is removed
